security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown inline code, code fences, tool names, or prose matches. The only contextual issue found is an optional Windows/WSL configuration that runs an unpinned npm package through npx. No prompt injection or malicious data exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npx package execution in Windows/WSL MCP setup.
remediation.suggestion: Pin mcp-remote to a reviewed version or document a versioned install path before use.

remediation.issue: Setup guidance can lead agents to modify MCP configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before adding the Linear MCP server or starting OAuth login.

static_findings.snippet: - Set `[features] rmcp_client = true` in `config.toml` **or** run `codex --enable rmcp_client`
- Leverage context: reference prior issues in new requests.
- Tool Calling Errors: Confirm the model supports multiple tool calls, provide all required fields,
- Break large updates into smaller batches to avoid rate limits; cache or reuse filters when listing

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned npm Package Execution in MCP Setup
semantic_findings.description: The Windows/WSL setup shows an MCP configuration that runs npx -y mcp-remote. Because no package version is pinned, a compromised or changed npm release could execute during setup.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 37 directly configures npx -y mcp-remote with no version pin. The behavior is setup-related, so risk is supply-chain exposure rather than confirmed malicious intent.

content.value_statement: Teams need current issue context before planning or changing work. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Linear MCP workflows for issues, projects, teams, comments, and documents.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup of the Linear MCP server with OAuth authentication.
Lists, reads, creates, and updates Linear issues through MCP tools.
Manages projects, teams, users, labels, cycles, comments, and documents.
Supports workflows for sprint planning, bug triage, documentation audits, and releases.
Recommends read-first batching before create or update operations.
limitations: Requires an accessible Linear workspace and OAuth permissions.
Depends on the Linear MCP server being configured before tool calls work.
Cannot bypass Linear permissions, rate limits, or archived project visibility.
Bulk changes need clear user scope to avoid unintended updates.

use_cases.title: Plan A Sprint
use_cases.description: Review open team issues, select priority work, and prepare cycle assignments with clear follow-up actions.

use_cases.title: Triage Bugs
use_cases.description: List critical and high-priority bugs, compare impact, and move selected issues toward an agreed status.

use_cases.title: Audit Documentation
use_cases.description: Search Linear documents, identify gaps, and create documentation issues with owners and labels.

prompt_templates.title: Show My Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Linear to list my assigned issues. Group them by status and flag anything blocked or missing an update.

prompt_templates.title: Triage Open Bugs
prompt_templates.prompt: List high-priority bugs for the backend team. Summarize impact, propose order, and ask before changing any statuses.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Release Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release plan after reviewing active projects, open blockers, and due dates. Draft milestones and issue groups before applying changes.

prompt_templates.title: Balance Team Workload
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare active issues by assignee for the platform team. Suggest reassignment options, explain tradeoffs, and only update Linear after approval.

output_examples.input: Find stale issues assigned to me and prepare status comments.
output: A grouped summary of assigned issues by status and age.
Draft status comments for stale issues that need updates.
A short list of blockers or missing decisions.

output_examples.input: Plan a documentation audit for API authentication.
output_examples.output: A documentation gap summary, proposed Linear issues, suggested labels, owners, and next review steps.

output_examples.input: Balance sprint work across the mobile team.
output_examples.output: A workload comparison by assignee, suggested reassignment options, and a request for approval before updates.

best_practices: Read existing issues and project data before creating or updating records.
Ask for team, project, label, priority, cycle, and due date details before bulk changes.
Summarize every update with remaining blockers and next recommended actions.
anti_patterns: Creating or updating many issues without confirming scope and identifiers.
Using broad searches when a specific team, project, or label is available.
Treating Linear suggestions as approved changes before user confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill require Linear access?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires OAuth access to the relevant Linear workspace and permissions for the requested teams or projects.

faq.question: Can it create and update issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide issue creation and updates through Linear MCP tools after required details are confirmed.

faq.question: Will it change Linear data automatically?
faq.answer: It should read first and ask before bulk changes, sensitive changes, or unclear updates.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when Linear MCP is available.

faq.question: What happens if Linear MCP is not configured?
faq.answer: The skill includes setup guidance for adding Linear MCP and logging in with OAuth.

faq.question: Can it manage documents and comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists and searches documents, reads comments, and creates comments through supported MCP tools.
